title: Pakistan Council of Architects and Town Planners Amendment Act 1994

sections.shortTitle: Pakistan Council of Architects and Town Planners Amendment Act 1994
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT IX OF 1994
ACT IX OF 1994
PAKISTAN COUNCIL OF ARCHITECTS AND TOWN PLANNERS (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1994
An Act to amend the Pakistan Council of Architects and Town Planners
Ordinance, 1983
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 15th June, 1994]
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the
Pakistan Council of Architects and Town Planners (Amendment) Act, 1994.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on the seventh day of March,
1993.

sections.shortTitle: Pakistan Council of Architects and Town Planners Amendment Act 1994
sections.description:
Amendment of section 3, Ordinance IX of 1983

ACT IX OF 1994
ACT IX OF 1994
PAKISTAN COUNCIL OF ARCHITECTS AND TOWN PLANNERS (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1994
An Act to amend the Pakistan Council of Architects and Town Planners
Ordinance, 1983
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 15th June, 1994]
2. Amendment of section 3, Ordinance IX of 1983.--In the Pakistan
Council of Architects and Town Planners Ordinance, 1983 (IX of 1983), in
section 3, in subsection (3), for the words and comma "for a period of ten
years or till a separate Council of Town Planners is constituted, whichever is
earlier" the words "till a separate council of Town Planners is
constituted" shall be substituted.
